aboutUs.storyDescription:
Nexgen Computer Academy was founded in 2021 with a clear mission: to bridge the gap between conventional learning and the practical skills required in today’s digital and professional world.

Since our beginning, we have focused on helping learners move beyond textbook knowledge through hands-on training, practical projects, modern technology and AI-powered tools. Our goal is to make learning more relevant, accessible and applicable to real-world situations.

Today, Nexgen Computer Academy provides career-focused training in IT & Computer Skills, AI, Digital Skills, Professional Development and French Language, helping learners build practical knowledge, confidence and skills for their academic, professional and career goals.

As technology and industry needs continue to evolve, Nexgen remains committed to continuously improving its learning approach and creating opportunities for learners to develop future-ready skills.
aboutUs.mission:
Our mission is to provide practical, accessible and career-focused education that equips learners with relevant IT, AI, digital, professional and language skills for today’s evolving world.

We are committed to combining hands-on learning, modern technology and real-world applications to help learners build confidence, develop meaningful skills and prepare for future opportunities.
aboutUs.vision:
Our vision is to become a trusted and forward-thinking skills development institute, empowering a future-ready generation through practical learning, emerging technologies and continuous innovation.

We aspire to create a learning environment where individuals can develop relevant skills, adapt to a changing world and confidently pursue their academic, professional and career goals.
aboutUs.directorMessage: Technology is the great equalizer of our era. When you have genuine, practical problem-solving skills, geographic boundaries disappear. At Nexgen, our promise is not just teaching software, but providing an end-to-end mentorship ecosystem until you secure your first client or corporate job. Welcome to your future.

policies.termsAndConditions:
Terms & Conditions

By enrolling in any course at Nexgen Computer Academy, students and guardians agree to comply with the following terms and conditions.

1. Course Enrollment

Course registration is confirmed after submission of the required information and payment of the applicable registration or course fee. Students are responsible for providing accurate information during registration.

2. Course Fees & Payments

Students must pay the applicable course fees according to the payment schedule provided by Nexgen Computer Academy. Any outstanding payment should be cleared within the specified deadline.

3. Discounts & Offers

Scholarships, discounts and promotional offers are subject to the terms, eligibility criteria and validity period specified by Nexgen Computer Academy. Offers may not always be combined with other promotions unless specifically stated.

4. Attendance

Regular attendance is strongly encouraged because the courses are practical and assignment-based. Students are expected to attend classes regularly and complete assigned practical work.

5. Class Schedule

Class schedules may occasionally be adjusted due to academic, operational or unforeseen circumstances. Nexgen Computer Academy reserves the right to change class dates or times when necessary and will communicate significant changes to students.

6. Course Content

Course modules, tools, software and learning activities may be updated from time to time to reflect changes in workplace technology and industry practices. The academy may make reasonable changes to the curriculum while maintaining the overall learning objectives of the program.

7. Practical Training

Students are expected to participate in practical exercises, assignments and projects. Individual learning outcomes may vary depending on attendance, practice, effort and prior knowledge.

8. AI Tools & Third-Party Services

Some training activities may involve third-party tools and AI platforms such as ChatGPT, Google Gemini, Canva and other services. Their availability, features, pricing and terms are controlled by the respective providers and may change independently of Nexgen Computer Academy.

9. Student Conduct

Students must maintain respectful and professional behaviour within the academy. Any activity that disrupts classes, damages academy property, harasses others or violates applicable laws may result in disciplinary action.

10. Academy Property & Equipment

Students are responsible for using academy computers, equipment and facilities carefully. Any intentional or negligent damage may be subject to applicable repair or replacement costs.

11. Learning Materials

Course materials, handouts, assignments, videos and other resources provided by Nexgen Computer Academy are intended for enrolled students and may not be reproduced, resold or distributed commercially without permission.

12. Photography & Media

The academy may occasionally take photographs or videos during classes, events or activities for educational or promotional purposes. Students or guardians who do not wish to appear in promotional materials may inform the academy in advance.

13. Refund & Cancellation

Course registration and payment terms are subject to the specific refund and cancellation policy communicated at the time of enrollment. Any applicable refund request must follow the academy's stated procedure and timeline.

14. Course Completion

Course completion requirements may include attendance, assignments, practical activities and other academic requirements specified for the particular program. Completion or participation in a course does not guarantee employment, freelancing clients, income or any specific career outcome.

15. Certificates

Where a course includes a certificate, eligibility and issuance requirements will be determined by the specific course policy. A certificate represents course participation or completion according to the applicable requirements and does not constitute a guarantee of employment.

16. Privacy

Information collected during registration or course participation will be handled for legitimate academic, administrative, communication and operational purposes in accordance with the academy's applicable privacy practices.

17. Changes to Terms

Nexgen Computer Academy may update these Terms & Conditions when necessary. Updated terms will apply from the date they are published or communicated, unless otherwise stated.

18. Contact

For questions regarding enrollment, fees, schedules, refunds or other course-related matters, students or guardians may contact Nexgen Computer Academy through the official communication channels provided on the website.

By registering for a course, the student or guardian acknowledges that they have read, understood and agreed to these Terms & Conditions.

Last Updated: September 2026
policies.privacyPolicy:
Privacy Policy

Nexgen Computer Academy respects your privacy and is committed to protecting the personal information you provide when using our website, contacting us, registering for a course or requesting information about our training programs.

This Privacy Policy explains what information we may collect, how we use it and how we protect it.

1. Information We Collect

Depending on how you interact with our website, we may collect information such as:

• Name
• Phone number
• Email address
• Course or program of interest
• Educational or professional information provided voluntarily
• Preferred class schedule
• Information submitted through registration, inquiry or contact forms
• Website usage and technical information

We only request information that is reasonably necessary for the relevant purpose.

2. How We Use Your Information

We may use the information you provide to:

• Respond to course inquiries and requests
• Process course registrations and admissions
• Contact you regarding classes, schedules, payments and course-related updates
• Provide information about courses, workshops, demo classes and relevant academy activities
• Improve our courses, website and learner experience
• Maintain administrative and academic records
• Prevent misuse, fraud or unauthorized activity
• Analyze website performance and marketing effectiveness

3. Communication

By submitting your contact information through our website or forms, you may be contacted by Nexgen Computer Academy regarding your inquiry, registration or course-related information.

Where appropriate, communications may take place through phone, SMS, email, WhatsApp or other communication channels you have provided.

4. Cookies & Similar Technologies

Our website may use cookies and similar technologies to improve functionality, understand website usage and measure the effectiveness of marketing campaigns.

Cookies may help us understand which pages visitors use, how visitors interact with the website and how we can improve the user experience.

You can manage or disable cookies through your browser settings. Some website features may not function properly if certain cookies are disabled.

5. Analytics & Marketing

We may use analytics and advertising technologies to understand website traffic, measure campaigns and improve our marketing activities.

Depending on the website configuration, these technologies may include services provided by third parties such as Google and Meta.

These third-party services may process information according to their own privacy policies and terms.

6. Third-Party Services

Our website or training programs may reference or integrate third-party services, platforms or AI tools such as Google services, Meta services, ChatGPT, Google Gemini, Canva and other technology platforms.

Nexgen Computer Academy does not control the privacy practices of third-party services. Users should review the relevant third party's privacy policy before providing information directly to those services.

7. Data Sharing

Nexgen Computer Academy does not sell your personal information as a business practice.

We may share limited information with trusted service providers when reasonably necessary to operate our website, manage registrations, communicate with learners, process payments, maintain technology systems or provide requested services.

We may also disclose information when required by applicable law or when reasonably necessary to protect our rights, users or property.

8. Data Security

We take reasonable administrative and technical measures to protect personal information against unauthorized access, misuse, loss or disclosure.

However, no internet transmission or electronic storage system can be guaranteed to be completely secure.

9. Data Retention

We may retain personal information for as long as reasonably necessary to provide services, maintain academic or administrative records, meet legal or operational requirements, resolve disputes and protect our legitimate interests.

10. Children's Privacy

Our website is not intended to knowingly collect unnecessary personal information from children. Where a course or service involves a minor, a parent or legal guardian may be required to provide appropriate consent or registration information.

11. Your Choices

You may contact Nexgen Computer Academy to request information about the personal data we hold about you or to request correction of inaccurate information, subject to applicable legal and operational requirements.

You may also choose not to provide optional information. However, certain information may be necessary to process registration or provide requested services.

12. External Links

Our website may contain links to external websites, platforms or services. Nexgen Computer Academy is not responsible for the privacy practices, content or security of external websites.

We encourage users to review the privacy policies of any external website they visit.

13. Policy Updates

We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time to reflect changes in our services, technology, legal requirements or business practices.

The updated version will be published on this page with the revised date.

14. Contact Us

If you have questions about this Privacy Policy, your personal information or our data practices, please contact Nexgen Computer Academy through the official contact information provided on our website.

Last Updated: September 2026

### 1. Refund Requests
Students may request a refund in writing within 3 calendar days of the official batch orientation. A nominal administrative processing fee of 10% will be deducted.

### 2. Post-Commencement Policy
No refund requests will be accepted once regular classroom curriculum sessions (Class 2 onwards) have commenced. However, students may request a batch transfer or course pause for valid medical or personal emergencies.
